CUSTOM PROVIDER PRICES

For private gateways and providers without their own public rates, the best matching original-provider price is used by default—for example, Anthropic's price for a Custom provider Claude model. Rates are USD per 1M tokens. Saved prices can be updated or reset at any time. Changes apply only to new messages; recorded history never changes. If no public match exists, the model stays at $0 until you save a price.
